messages:
Sam (AcmeApp): Hey folks — our calls to the /v1/rerank endpoint started returning a 413 this morning. Works fine with small doc sets, but fails when query is long and we send ~180 docs. No obvious change on our side. Any quick workarounds?

Maya (Support): Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a minimal curl (no secrets) and the X-Request-Id from the response? Also roughly how long is the average doc (chars or tokens)?

Sam (AcmeApp): Repro below (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"'""Very long user query repeated 100x..."'"", "documents":[{"id":"1","text":"<very long doc 1>"}, {"id":"2","text":"<very long doc 2>"}, ... up to 180 docs]}'
```
Response: 413 Payload Too Large, body: `{\"error\":\"payload too large\"}`. No request id in the body, but response headers had: X-Request-Id: rq_8f7a...

ErrorBot: ingress: request=rq_8f7a status=413 token_count=12321 field=documents

Maya (Support): Thanks — token_count in the logs is useful. Looks like combined token budget exceeded (query + sum(docs)). Two immediate options for you: 1) snippeting: send only 2-3 paragraphs per doc (we usually keep doc snippets < 512 tokens), or 2) batch the rerank calls (split docs into multiple requests and merge scores). Both are quick fixes while we dig into the UX.

Priya (ML Eng): Confirming what Maya said. Rerank currently enforces a hard token ceiling at the edge; if the request exceeds it we return 413 with that opaque message. The important piece to add: the error should include which field caused the exceed and the token totals so customers can programmatically decide to chunk. Example: `error: token_limit_exceeded, total_tokens: 12321, max_tokens: 8000, offending_field: documents`.

Sam (AcmeApp): That would help a lot. Right now we have to guess whether it was the query vs docs. We can implement snippeting quickly if you confirm recommended snippet sizes.

Priya (ML Eng): Recommendation: prefer snippets ~256–512 tokens for rerank workloads. If you need full-doc context for downstream steps, do a 2-step flow: 1) rerank on snippets to get top N doc ids, 2) fetch full docs and run the heavier LLM call on the top candidates.

Leo (DevEx): I'll draft a short KB/example showing: a) how to compute token counts client-side (example code + tiktoken link), b) snippet pattern with curl and pseudocode for batching, and c) CLI script to auto-chunk. Also I can propose the error text change in the API errors RFC. @Priya can you +1 the phrasing when I post?

Priya (ML Eng): +1 to that plan. Also note: we should include a link in the error to the KB so customers can click straight through. e.g., `error: token_limit_exceeded (12321/8000) — see https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#token_limit`

Maya (Support): Copy. I will ask Sam if they'd like an interim workaround from our side (we can proxy their calls and auto-snippet), but wouldn't recommend for long term. Sam — want us to try a quick proxy patch to keep you unblocked while you implement client changes?

Sam (AcmeApp): That would be amazing for a day or two while we roll the snippeting. We'll accept the proxy help. Thanks all.

Leo (DevEx): Filed: DOCS-456 — KB draft + snippet examples. API-ERR-98 — change to token_limit error payload (include totals + offending_field + docs link). I'll drop a PR for the KB and ping the API team.

Maya (Support): Marking this thread as high priority for the customer. Moving to DM with Sam for details. :thumbsup:
